Experience Sacred Music in Pushkar’s Most Spiritual Setting

Step onto the rooftop of the historic Ranji Temple as the sun sets over Pushkar Lake. Candles flicker, incense fills the air, and the sound of harmonium and tabla begins. You’re surrounded by fellow seekers from around the world, all gathered for one purpose: to connect with the divine through music.

Our devotional music nights aren’t passive concerts—they’re participatory experiences. When the kirtan leader chants “Hare Krishna, Hare Rama,” you respond with the same words. Your voice merges with dozens of others, creating a wave of spiritual energy. No musical experience needed. No judgment. Just pure devotion and surrender through sound.

Whether you’re attending our public Friday nights or we’re performing at your private event, you’ll experience the authentic power of Bhajan, Kirtan, and Sufi Qawwali—ancient traditions that have moved hearts for centuries, now accessible to seekers from every corner of the globe.

Traditional & Spiritual Music We Perform

🙏

Bhajan

Devotional songs to Krishna, Ram, Shiva & Devi. Melodic, meditative, soul-stirring hymns rooted in Indian classical ragas.

🕉️

Kirtan

Call-and-response mantra chanting. The leader sings, the group repeats. High-energy, participatory, and deeply connecting.

🕊️

Sufi Qawwali

Mystical Islamic devotional poetry set to ecstatic rhythms. Transcendent, passionate, and spiritually intoxicating.

🧘

Mantra Meditation

Sacred Sanskrit mantras—Om, Gayatri, Maha Mrityunjaya. Chanted repetitively for deep meditative states and healing.

🎪

Rajasthani Folk Bhajans

Regional devotional music from Rajasthan’s desert communities. Colorful, rhythmic, and culturally rich.

🔔

Aarti Songs

Temple ritual music performed during fire ceremonies. Devotional songs accompanied by bells, cymbals, and drums.

Location & Setting

Ranji Temple Rooftop, Pushkar

Our devotional music nights take place on the rooftop of the historic Ranji Temple, one of Pushkar’s most sacred and serene locations. With panoramic views of Pushkar Lake and the surrounding Aravalli hills, the setting itself is a meditation.

  • Atmosphere: Open-air, candlelit, with temple bells and incense
  • Capacity: Intimate gatherings of up to 30 people
  • Accessibility: 5-minute walk from Brahma Temple & main market
  • Seating: Floor cushions & yoga mats provided (bring shawl if cold)
  • What to Bring: Open heart, modest clothing, water bottle
  • Parking: Not available—walking distance from most guesthouses
📍 Exact address & directions shared upon booking confirmation via WhatsApp.

Getting There

From Brahma Temple: Walk towards Pushkar Lake, turn left at Ranji Temple (near Varah Ghat). Look for signs or ask any local—everyone knows Krishna Music School!

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need to know the mantras or bhajans to participate?

Not at all! Kirtan is call-and-response. The leader sings a line, then everyone repeats it together. No prior knowledge needed. Lyrics are also displayed if you want to follow along. Just open your voice and heart.

Is this religious? Can people of any faith attend?

While Bhajan, Kirtan, and Qawwali come from Hindu and Sufi devotional traditions, our events are open to people of ALL faiths or no faith. Many attendees are spiritual seekers who approach it as meditation through sound rather than religious worship. Everyone is welcome with respect.

What should I wear?

Comfortable, modest clothing suitable for sitting cross-legged on the floor. Since we’re in a sacred temple space, please cover shoulders and knees out of respect. Remove shoes before entering the rooftop area.

How long do the events last?

Regular Friday kirtan nights are 2 hours (7:00 PM – 9:00 PM). Full moon Sufi qawwali nights run 2.5 hours (8:00 PM – 10:30 PM). Feel free to arrive early and stay after for chai and connection.

Can I take photos or videos during the event?

Yes, photography is allowed, but we encourage presence over phones. We’ll have a designated photo time before/after the session. During deep chanting, we request silence and no flash to maintain the sacred atmosphere.

Is food or drink included?

Yes! All tickets include complimentary chai (Indian spiced tea) and prasad (blessed food—usually cookies or fruit). VIP ticket holders also receive a special sweet treat.

How do I book tickets for public events?

Contact us via WhatsApp at +91 99286 58520 with your preferred date and number of tickets. Payment can be made in advance (UPI, PayPal, card) or in cash at the door. We recommend booking at least 24 hours ahead as spots fill up.

What’s the cancellation policy for tickets?

If you cancel 24+ hours before the event, you’ll receive a full refund or can transfer your ticket to another date. Cancellations within 24 hours or no-shows are non-refundable.

How far in advance should I book for private events?

We recommend at least 2 weeks’ notice for private bookings. For popular dates (weekends, festivals, wedding season Oct-March), book 1-2 months in advance. Rush bookings sometimes possible—contact us to check availability.

What does a private devotional concert cost?

Starting at €170 ($180 USD) for a 1.5-hour performance with 3 musicians. Price varies based on duration, number of performers, location, and specific requirements. We offer custom packages. Contact us for a detailed quote.

Do you travel outside of Pushkar for private bookings?

Yes! We regularly perform in Jaipur, Ajmer, Udaipur, and throughout Rajasthan. Travel costs added to base price. We’ve also traveled to other Indian states for special retreats and weddings.

Can I request specific bhajans, mantras, or songs?

Absolutely! For private bookings, we customize the setlist to your preferences. Want only Krishna bhajans? Sufi qawwali? Specific mantras for chakra meditation? Just let us know when booking.

Is the rooftop accessible for people with limited mobility?

The venue requires climbing stairs (no elevator). If you have mobility concerns, please contact us—we can arrange private devotional concerts at accessible ground-level locations in Pushkar.

What if it rains during an outdoor event?

The rooftop is covered, so light rain is fine. In heavy monsoon rain, we move indoors to a backup location nearby. All ticket holders are notified via WhatsApp/email if venue changes.
